name: Today Tripura MCP Server
description: Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Today Tripura. Exposes tools for searching news, fetching top stories, exploring categories, and inspecting site feeds.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search latest news, articles, and breaking reports from Today Tripura

tools.name: get_latest_news
tools.description: Retrieve current top news headlines and breaking alerts

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: List all active news categories and topic sections
